svg.title: Fsm Lidar Reading
svg.desc: State machine run by the serial receive (RXC) interrupt to parse LiDAR data. State 0 waits for the character 'G' and resets the buffer index. State 1 reads the 12 header bytes (counting with G_count) and returns to state 0 if the 11th byte is not '0'. It then alternates between state 2 high byte (temp = (RXC - 0x30) shifted left 6) and state 2 low byte (dist = temp + RXC - 0x30; distances 0 to 6 become MAX and 16 becomes 4096; store in the ping/pong array), skipping line feeds. After a second line feed the end-of-stream state triggers software interrupt SWI2, toggles the ping/pong buffer and returns to state 0. LADAR RXC Parsing State Machine (Fixed Loops)
